name: Bello Testarossa
original_name: ベッロ・テスタロッサ
source:
A celebrity from a prominent Italian family who has moved into the neighborhood. She has a clear mind and speaks fluent Japanese, but she is proud and haughty with an outlandish mind.

She treats Takurou like commoner filth.

She has traveled around the world and is currently staying in one of her homes in Japan on a whim.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/saimin/]Official site[/url]]
